messages:
mira: Just finished provisioning the new eu-west-gpu cluster (region eu-west-3). Pushing initial validation artifacts now.

alex: Nice — can you paste the quick checklist you ran? want to grab anything before handoff.

mira: Sure. Short list:
- node count = 12 (8x A100 + 4x T4 reserved for burst)
- kube nodes ready
- nv_peer_mem and rdma loaded on A100 nodes
- networking: calico healthy, BGP peering established to core-router
- storage: 600GB local ephemeral available per pod group
- admission webhook for pod annotation validation deployed

sujan: Any surprises on quotas? did cloud quota request go through for GPUs?

mira: Yes — quota bump approved but only 10 A100s initially. I followed up and cloud support escalated, ETA 3h for final 8->12. For now we used instance affinity to spread critical services.

julie: FYI cost estimate: projected monthly spend for baseline (non-burst) ~ $56k/mo. Includes networking egress assumptions. If we flip burst pool on full we hit ~$80k/mo.

alex: Can we throttle burst by schedule or policy? opsbot: configured autoscaler policy #eu-west-gpu-burst -> max 4 burst nodes, cool-down 15m.

mira: Validation commands I ran:
```
# check GPU plugin
kubectl -n kube-system get daemonset nvidia-device-plugin -o wide

# sample perf test
kubectl run -i --rm perf --image=redwood/perf:latest --requests='cpu=1,memory=2Gi,nvidia.com/gpu=1' -- bash -c "python3 /app/llm_latency_test.py --tokens 128"
```

alex: Any flaky failures?

mira: A few pods in the first hour failed with OOM on T4 nodegroup — turned out default resource limits in the template were too low. Increased container memory to 8Gi for model-proxy and rerolled.

sujan: Noted. Anything network-y?

mira: There was one BGP flap between eu-core-1 and the new cluster edge. Route convergence took ~45s which caused short 5xx spikes in onboarding proxy. Worked with neteng and found MTU mismatch on the transit link — fixed to 9001. eng-bot: incident created (INC-2026-eu3-bgp-mtu).

julie: Add that as "known issue" in runbook: BGP flap due to MTU mismatch -> symptoms, mitigation, postmortem link.

mira: Added to the runbook draft in the docs repo. Also added a small troubleshooting snippet for 5xx spike:
```
# quick check
kubectl get pods -n model-proxy -o wide | grep CrashLoop
curl -sS -D - http://onboarding-proxy.internal/health | head
# check bgp
sudo vtysh -c 'show ip bgp summary'
```

alex: Great. Who's owning handoff to SRE for oncall?

mira: I can do the initial 24h oncall coverage. After that, sujan takes over. I've created the rotation in PagerDuty.

sujan: Confirmed. Will run a 2h stress test at 02:00 UTC tomorrow (generate synthetic traffic at 60 qps with varied seq lengths). Please ensure tracing is enabled for that window.

mira: Tracing and token-level cost logs are on. Also enabling debug-level kernel metrics for the runtime during the stress window.

julie: A couple of housekeeping items before full handoff:
- add cost center tag to all VM resources (CC: infra-eu)
- enable longer retention for console logs for 30d (we normally keep 7d)
- ensure KMS keys are added to the cluster key policy

mira: Done for cost tags and log retention. KMS key will need an owner to finish IAM binding. tagging opsbot for KMS. opsbot: KMS request ticket created (KMS-451).

alex: Any end-user facing changes? Will teams need to update endpoint names?

mira: No — we registered the new model endpoint under the existing regional alias: api.eu-west. No DNS changes for clients.

sujan: Known issues summary for handoff (copy from runbook):
- quota delay on initial A100 count (mitigation: request early and have burst policy)
- MTU mismatch causing bgp flaps -> check transit MTU 9001
- memory defaults too low for some T4 workloads -> set container mem >= 8Gi
- unexpected ephemeral storage pressure during large batch jobs -> enforce pvc-backed scratch for batch pods

mira: I'm attaching the runbook PR link in the docs channel after this thread. Also adding short checklist for SRE run:
1) verify node counts and GPU plugin readiness
2) run perf job against sample model, capture p95/p99
3) validate BGP adjacency and no flaps in last 10m
4) confirm autoscaler / burst policy limits
5) verify billing tags and KMS binding
6) rotate credentials for bootstrap service account

julie: Perfect. Once SRE confirms the 24h smoke is clean we can flip traffic flag to "prod-ready" and update cost projection.

mira: Handoff: mira -> sujan after 24h. Leaving checklist and runbook links in the handoff doc. :thumbsup:

eng-bot: deployment eu-west-gpu cluster completed at 1772504000; status: stable

sujan: I'll start the stress test tomorrow and post results here. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

mira: Closing this thread after notes are copied to docs. If anyone finds anything else, ping me.

opsbot: Reminder: schedule patch window for kernel updates next week (window: Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC).
